purpose: Full combined PFDSIM temperature-dependent NRTL/UNIQUAC binary interaction parameter set from the alcohol/ether survey and reliable additional systems found in the supplied papers.

conventions.component_order: Parameters 12 and 21 follow the components array order.

criteria: stability to leaving out an independent source
independent temperature leverage rather than composition-temperature confounding
model_selection.note: No c*T term was retained: apparent SSE improvements did not survive identifiability/stability checks.

original_question_definition.meaning: A binary pair containing exactly one listed alcohol and exactly one listed ether.

gao_2012.citation: Gao et al., Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Research 51 (2012) 567-575
gao_2012.vapor_basis: gamma-phi; Hayden-O'Connell vapor fugacity, saturated-vapor fugacity correction, Poynting correction, modified Rackett liquid volume
gao_2012.title: Correlation and Prediction for Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria of the Diethyl Ether + Methanol + 1-Butanol Ternary System and the Constituent Binary Systems at 101.325 kPa
gao_2012.experimental_scope: Full T-x-y VLE for DEE + methanol, DEE + 1-butanol, and methanol + 1-butanol at 101.325 kPa; ternary measured separately.
gao_2012.provenance_note: Constituent binary parameters were independently fitted; the ternary was predicted from those binary parameters without additional adjustment.

lladosa_2006.citation: Lladosa et al., Fluid Phase Equilibria 247 (2006) 47-53
lladosa_2006.vapor_basis: ideal vapor at 20 and 101.3 kPa; liquid pressure dependence neglected
lladosa_2006.title: Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibria for the binary systems 1-propyl alcohol + dipropyl ether and 1-butyl alcohol + dibutyl ether at 20 and 101.3 kPa
lladosa_2006.experimental_scope: Full T-x-y VLE for 1-propanol + DPE and 1-butanol + DBE at 20 and 101.3 kPa.
lladosa_2006.provenance_note: Published global regressions combine both pressures with Aij = Aij0 + Aij1*T. Source states UNIQUAC volume/surface parameters were from DECHEMA but does not print their numerical r/q values.

reddy_2013.citation: Reddy, Benecke & Ramjugernath, Journal of Chemical Thermodynamics 58 (2013) 330-339
reddy_2013.vapor_basis: gamma-phi; truncated two-term virial EOS with Hayden-O'Connell second virials, saturation fugacity and Poynting corrections
reddy_2013.title: Isothermal (vapour + liquid) equilibria for binary mixtures of diisopropyl ether with (methanol, or ethanol, or 1-butanol): Experimental data, correlations, and predictions
reddy_2013.experimental_scope: P-x-y VLE at 305.15/315.15/325.15 K for DIPE + methanol, 313.15/323.15/333.15 K for DIPE + ethanol, and 318.15/338.15 K for DIPE + 1-butanol.
reddy_2013.provenance_note: PFDSIM entries are global temperature-dependent refits to the multi-isotherm information rather than interpolation of the separately published isotherm parameters. Source calculations used Aspen Plus; numerical UNIQUAC r/q values are not printed in the paper.

cartes_2021.vapor_basis: ideal vapor modified Raoult law at 94 kPa; liquid fugacity pressure dependence neglected
cartes_2021.title: Measurements and modeling of the phase equilibria for the n-hexane + ethanol + dibutyl ether ternary mixture and its dibutyl ether sub-binary mixtures at 94 kPa
cartes_2021.experimental_scope: T-x-y VLE for n-hexane + DBE and ethanol + DBE, plus ternary, at 94 kPa.
cartes_2021.provenance_note: Source prints the exact DECHEMA UNIQUAC structural parameters used: n-hexane 4.4998/3.8560, ethanol 2.1055/1.972, DBE 6.0925/5.176.

wang_2020.citation: Wang et al., Journal of Chemical & Engineering Data 65 (2020) 4387-4394
wang_2020.vapor_basis: ideal-vapor approximation at 101.3 kPa; vapor fugacity and Poynting corrections taken as approximately unity
wang_2020.title: Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium of Binary Systems (Isopropyl Acetate/Isopropyl Alcohol + Dibutyl Ether/Anisole) at 101.3 kPa
wang_2020.experimental_scope: T-x-y VLE for IPAC + DBE, IPAC + anisole, IPA + DBE, and IPA + anisole at 101.3 kPa.
wang_2020.provenance_note: Source prints the exact Aspen-databank UNIQUAC r/q values used and already publishes a+b/T forms.

soujanya_2014.citation: Soujanya, Satyavathi & Sankarshana, Fluid Phase Equilibria 382 (2014) 286-299
soujanya_2014.vapor_basis: low-pressure bubble-point treatment; no separate HOC correction documented for the activity-coefficient fits
soujanya_2014.title: Experimental isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium at atmospheric and sub-atmospheric pressures, excess molar volumes and deviations in molar refractivity from 293.15 K to 318.15 K of diisopropyl ether with methanol and isopropyl alcohol
soujanya_2014.experimental_scope: Bubble-temperature/composition measurements for DIPE + IPA and methanol + DIPE at 53.3, 66.7, 79.9, and 94.79 kPa; no independent measured vapor-composition series used in the PFDSIM replacement fit.
soujanya_2014.provenance_note: Old PFDSIM DIPE + IPA fit from this paper is retired; stronger multi-source data replace it.

lladosa_2007.citation: Lladosa et al., Fluid Phase Equilibria 262 (2007) 271-279
lladosa_2007.vapor_basis: ideal-vapor modified Raoult law; liquid pressure dependence neglected; justified by low pressure
lladosa_2007.title: Effect of pressure and the capability of 2-methoxyethanol as a solvent in the behaviour of a diisopropyl ether-isopropyl alcohol azeotropic mixture
lladosa_2007.experimental_scope: Full T-x-y VLE for DIPE + IPA at 30 and 101.3 kPa and DIPE + 2-methoxyethanol / IPA + 2-methoxyethanol at 101.3 kPa.
lladosa_2007.parameter_location: Table 9 for 101.3-kPa binaries; Table 10 for global DIPE + IPA parameters
lladosa_2007.provenance_note: Source states UNIQUAC volume/surface parameters were from DECHEMA but does not print the numerical r/q values.

arce_2003.citation: Arce et al., Journal of Chemical Thermodynamics 35 (2003) 871-884
arce_2003.vapor_basis: gamma-phi; Hayden-O'Connell second-virial vapor fugacity; saturated-vapor fugacity and Poynting correction; Rackett liquid volume
arce_2003.title: (Vapour + liquid) equilibrium of (DIPE + IPA + water) at 101.32 kPa
arce_2003.experimental_scope: Thermodynamically consistent T-x-y VLE for DIPE + IPA and IPA + water plus the ternary at 101.32 kPa.
arce_2003.provenance_note: Uses Hayden-O'Connell vapor correction. For UNIQUAC the paper states r/q came from Daubert & Danner and explicitly uses q0 (q-prime) = 0.89 for IPA and 1.00 for water; this is not silently interchangeable with ordinary UNIQUAC.

chamorro_2002.citation: Chamorro et al., Journal of Chemical Thermodynamics 34 (2002) 13-28
chamorro_2002.vapor_basis: Barker total-pressure reduction; second-virial EOS with Hayden-O'Connell coefficients
chamorro_2002.title: Isothermal v.l.e. and excess molar Gibbs energy of binary and ternary mixtures containing diisopropyl ether, n-heptane and isopropanol at T = 313.15 K
chamorro_2002.experimental_scope: High-precision isothermal total-pressure data for DIPE + n-heptane, DIPE + IPA, IPA + n-heptane, and the ternary at 313.15 K; vapor compositions obtained by Barker reduction.
chamorro_2002.provenance_note: Second-virial vapor EOS with Hayden-O'Connell coefficients. Paper uses UNIQUAC r/q but does not print their numerical values.

shawaqfeh_2010.vapor_basis: gamma-phi; virial EOS with Hayden-O'Connell second virials; modified Rackett liquid volume; Antoine vapor pressures
shawaqfeh_2010.title: Isobaric Vapor-liquid equilibrium for the binary system Diisopropylether + Isopropanol at 95 kPa
shawaqfeh_2010.experimental_scope: Full T-x-y VLE for DIPE + IPA at 95 kPa.
shawaqfeh_2010.provenance_note: Used as independent validation for the PFDSIM multi-source DIPE + IPA fit.

lepori_2000.citation: Lepori et al., Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics 2 (2000) 4837-4842
lepori_2000.vapor_basis: head-space GC; virial vapor nonideality correction including air represented as nitrogen; corrections generally under 4%
lepori_2000.title: Isothermal vapour/liquid equilibria of binary mixtures with dibutyl ether at 298.15 K
lepori_2000.experimental_scope: Head-space GC VLE at 298.15 K for DBE with hexane, octane, DEE, THF, propylamine, butylamine, propanone, cyclopentanone, methanol, 1-butanol, and acetonitrile.
lepori_2000.parameter_location: Raw x, ln(gamma1/gamma2), y, P in electronic supplementary Table S1; source Redlich-Kister smoothing in main-paper Table 2.
lepori_2000.provenance_note: PFDSIM NRTL/UNIQUAC entries are refits to the raw supplementary ln(gamma1/gamma2) values, not copied source BIPs.

revision_notes: Added explicit entry-level and per-model recommended fields to every active entry.
Filled missing temperature ranges and refined several existing ranges to exact experimental source spans.
Standardized active dibutyl-ether UNIQUAC r/q to 6.0925/5.1760 and active 2-propanol r/q to 2.7791/2.5080.

For the four fits that previously used conflicting r/q values, transformed UNIQUAC parameters by matching the prior model surface; source-specific r/q and pre-standardization parameters remain preserved for provenance.
Collapsed those four standardized UNIQUAC fits to one-term b/T because the extra intercept terms were unnecessary/ill-conditioned; the largest surface change is <0.0071 in ln(gamma).
Repaired accented author names and normalized all JSON strings to Unicode NFC.
No active binary entries were added or removed.

methanol_standard.reference: Common original-UNIQUAC value; also equal to the original-UNIFAC CH3OH subgroup geometry.

1_propanol_standard.reference: Common original-UNIQUAC value used in published thermodynamic work.

2_propanol_standard.reference: Common original-UNIQUAC/DECHEMA-style value used in published thermodynamic work.

1_butanol_standard.reference: Common original-UNIQUAC value used in published thermodynamic work.

dipropyl_ether_standard.reference: Published original-UNIQUAC value; compatible reconstruction of the DECHEMA basis stated by Lladosa 2006.

diisopropyl_ether_pfdisim_basis.reference: Published UNIQUAC molecular volume/surface values; explicitly fixed for PFDSIM refits.

2_methoxyethanol_jced1993.reference: J. Chem. Eng. Data 38 (1993) 128-131, UNIQUAC structural parameters.

n_heptane_standard.reference: Common original-UNIQUAC value; published tables commonly report r=5.1742, q=4.396.

propylamine_unifac_geometry_proxy.derivation: CH3 + CH2 + CH2NH2 using published original-UNIFAC subgroup R/Q values.
propylamine_unifac_geometry_proxy.warning: Used only to make an explicit, reproducible exploratory UNIQUAC fit; not claimed to be a source-native molecular UNIQUAC parameter.

butylamine_unifac_geometry_proxy.derivation: CH3 + 2*CH2 + CH2NH2 using published original-UNIFAC subgroup R/Q values.
butylamine_unifac_geometry_proxy.warning: Used only to make an explicit, reproducible exploratory UNIQUAC fit; not claimed to be a source-native molecular UNIQUAC parameter.

cyclopentanone_unifac_geometry_proxy.derivation: CH2CO + 3*CH2 using published original-UNIFAC subgroup R/Q values.
cyclopentanone_unifac_geometry_proxy.warning: Approximate group-derived geometry; used only for a non-recommended exploratory UNIQUAC fit.

dibutyl_ether_canonical.reference: DECHEMA value printed explicitly by Cartes et al. (2021).

uniquac_r_q_policy.policy: Active UNIQUAC entries use the canonical values above. Source-specific alternatives are retained only as provenance. Where a source fit used a conflicting r/q basis, the active BIPs were transformed by matching the old model surface rather than changing r/q underneath unchanged BIPs.
